resolved.title: 二进制文件I/O
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Binary File I/O[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Writing only characters and strings to a file can become tedious when you have an array or structure. To write entire blocks of memory to a file, there are the following binary functions:

Binary file mode options for the fopen() function are:
 - [b]rb[/b] open for reading (file must exist)
 - [b]wb[/b] open for writing (file need not exist)
 - [b]ab[/b] open for append (file need not exist)
 - [b]rb+[/b] open for reading and writing from beginning
 - [b]wb+[/b] open for reading and writing, overwriting file
 - [b]ab+[/b] open for reading and writing, appending to file

[b]fwrite(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp)[/b] Writes [i]num_items[/i] items of [i]item_size[/i] size from pointer [i]ptr[/i] to the file pointed to by file pointer [i]fp[/i].

[b]fread(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp)[/b] Reads [i]num_items[/i] items of [i]item_size[/i] size from the file pointed to by file pointer [i]fp[/i] into memory pointed to by [i]ptr[/i].

[b]fclose(fp)[/b] Closes file opened with file [i]fp[/i], returning 0 if close was successful. [b]EOF[/b] is returned if there is an error in closing.
[note][b]feof(fp)[/b] Returns 0 when the end of the file stream has been reached.[/note]

content.text:
当你有一个数组或结构体时，只将字符和字符串写到文件中会变得很乏味。

要将整个内存块写入文件，则需要以二进制模式打开文件，`fopen()`函数模式选项如下：

- **rb**: 为读取而打开（文件必须存在）
- **wb**: 为写而打开（文件不需要存在）
- **ab**: 为附加而打开(文件不需要存在)
- **rb+**: 为读和写从头打开
- **wb+**: 为读和写打开，覆盖文件
- **ab+**: 为读和写打开，附加到文件上

其中：
- `fwrite(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp)` 将num_items个item_size大小的项目从指针ptr写入文件指针fp所指向的文件。

- `fread(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp)` 从文件指针fp所指向的文件中读取item_size大小的num_items项到ptr所指向的内存中。

- `fclose(fp)` 关闭以文件fp打开的文件，如果关闭成功，则返回0。如果关闭错误，则返回EOF。
content.text_html:
Writing only characters and strings to a file can become tedious when you have an array or structure. To write entire blocks of memory to a file, there are the following binary functions:

Binary file mode options for the fopen() function are:

  • rb open for reading (file must exist)
  • wb open for writing (file need not exist)
  • ab open for append (file need not exist)
  • rb+ open for reading and writing from beginning
  • wb+ open for reading and writing, overwriting file
  • ab+ open for reading and writing, appending to file

fwrite(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp) Writes num_items items of item_size size from pointer ptr to the file pointed to by file pointer fp.

fread(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp) Reads num_items items of item_size size from the file pointed to by file pointer fp into memory pointed to by ptr.

fclose(fp) Closes file opened with file fp, returning 0 if close was successful. EOF is returned if there is an error in closing.

当你有一个数组或结构时，只将字符和字符串写到文件中会变得很乏味。要将整个内存块写入文件，有以下二进制函数。

fopen()函数的二进制文件模式选项是：。

  • rb 为阅读而打开（文件必须存在）
  • wb 为写而打开（文件不需要存在）
  • ab 为附加而打开(文件不需要存在)
  • rb+ 为读和写从头打开
  • wb+ 为读和写打开，覆盖文件
  • ab+ 为读和写打开，附加到文件上

fwrite(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp) 从指针ptr向文件指针fp所指向的文件写入num_items项，其大小为item_size。

fread(ptr, item_size, num_items, fp) 从文件指针fp所指向的文件中读取item_size大小的num_items项到ptr所指向的内存。

fclose(fp) 关闭用文件fp打开的文件，如果关闭成功，返回0。如果关闭时有错误，则返回EOF。

resolved.title: 控制文件读写位置

content.text:
在`stdio.h`中有一些函数用于控制二进制文件中文件指针的位置。

`ftell(fp)` 返回一个long int值，该值对应于fp文件指针位置（从文件开头开始的字节数）。

`fseek(fp, num_bytes, from_pos)` 将 fp 文件指针的位置相对于from_pos位置移动num_bytes个字节，

该位置可以是以下常量之一：

- `SEEK_SET`: 文件的开始

- `SEEK_CUR`: 当前位置

- `SEEK_END`: 文件结尾

There are functions in stdio.h for controlling the location of the file pointer in a binary file: ftell(fp) Returns a long int value corresponding to the fp file pointer position in number of bytes from the start of the file.

fseek(fp, num_bytes, from_pos) Moves the fp file pointer position by num_bytes bytes relative to position from_pos, which can be one of the following constants: ** - SEEK_SET** start of file ** - SEEK_CUR** current position ** - SEEK_END** end of file
